title: Geo Companion
summary: An independent browser companion to Geo for exploring educational evidence, connected ideas, and an Indianapolis outreach pilot.
description:
Geo Companion asks what becomes possible when shared knowledge has a useful interface. It reads public Geo content and turns bounded slices of that graph into education dashboards, relationship explorers, and maps. You can follow connections and inspect the sources behind a finding without needing a wallet just to browse.

My teaching background shapes the question behind the project: does a dashboard help someone ask a better question or make a useful decision? The education views connect programs, studies, and findings, with quantitative plots only where the measurements support comparison. Connections and popularity are not evidence that a claim is true.

The Indianapolis outreach app is an early directory-and-map pilot. Service schedules and food classifications still need verification; it should not be treated as a complete or current guide to help available today. The application currently reads Geo testnet, so content and availability can change.

Open the live site to explore, or read the public repository for the architecture, source boundaries, and unfinished work. Geo Companion is independent of the Geo team. Geo contributors, researchers, outreach organizations, and upstream open-source maintainers retain credit for the knowledge and tools it builds on.
